function.name: Movies_3_FindMovies
function.description: Retrieves a list of movies based on the director, genre, and cast specified by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

directed_by.description: Director of the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the director is not a specific search criterion.

genre.description: Genre of the movie. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres or genre is not specified by user

cast.description: Names of leading actors or actresses in the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the cast is not a specific search criterion.

There's no "Imaginative fiction" in the list. We need to interpret "Imaginative fiction" as maybe "Fantasy" or "Sci-fi" or "Fantasy-type movies". The user says they have started to watch a lot of fantasy-type movies. So we can suggest a fantasy movie. We can ask clarifying question? The user says "I would like to find a movie to watch in the Imaginative fiction genre, as I have started to watch a lot of fantasy-type movies lately, you know!!!!!!"

We could interpret "Imaginative fiction" as "Fantasy". So we can call the function with genre: "Fantasy". No director or cast specified. So directed_by: "dontcare", cast: "dontcare". Then we call the function.
